description: This file defines reference counting base classes, traits, and smart pointer templates for managing object lifetime in a thread-safe manner within the starboard namespace.

classes.name: RefCounted
classes.description: A non-thread-safe reference counted base class for objects, requiring manual management.

classes.name: RefCountedThreadSafe
classes.description: A thread-safe variant of RefCounted, managing object lifetime with atomic reference counting.

classes.name: RefCountedData
classes.description: A thread-safe wrapper for data, enabling reference counting of the contained data.

classes.name: scoped_refptr
classes.description: A smart pointer class for managing reference counted objects, automating AddRef/Release calls.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count of the object.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and deletes the object if count reaches zero.

methods.name: Destruct
methods.description: Default trait method to delete the object, can be overloaded for custom behavior.

methods.name: DeleteInternal
methods.description: Internal method to delete the object, used by traits.
